metaDescriptions.accordionTitle: Customer analytics software for B2B SaaS
metaDescriptions.accordionBody:
June is a Product & Customer Analytics Software, designed to seamlessly integrate product analytics with customer success strategies.

Our platform provides a 360-degree view of user behaviour, from the initial activation to ongoing engagement, allowing you to pinpoint where users thrive and where they drop off.

With real-time insights into key customer analytics metrics such as activation rates, feature adoption, and engagement patterns, you can proactively identify and mitigate churn risks.

When integrated with your own CRM system, June equips your customer success and sales teams with the tools they need to build personalised retention strategies, ensuring that users remain loyal and invested in your product. They will be able to identify upsell and account expansion opportunities, convert free trials into paying customers, effortlessly manage SaaS renewals processes and predict and prevent users churn. By leveraging our comprehensive analytics and customer success capabilities and content resources, you'll not only enhance user satisfaction but also drive long-term growth and maximise customer lifetime value.

metaDescriptions.accordionTitle: Product Analytics Case Studies and Customer Reviews
metaDescriptions.accordionBody:
Read product analytics case studies that have empowered various B2B SaaS companies to achieve deeper user engagement and optimise their growth strategies thanks to June.

By integrating our customer analytics software with platforms like HubSpot, businesses such as Knack and Commandbar have streamlined user data into their CRM systems, enabling teams to proactively address customer needs, build tailored customer engagement strategies and improve onboarding processes.

With insights into real-time product usage, companies have refined their outreach and feature development, resulting in effective churn prevention and enhanced customer satisfaction.

These product analytics case studies showcase how June drives efficient, data-informed decision-making across product and customer success teams.

metaDescriptions.accordionTitle: How do customer health scores work with product analytics?
metaDescriptions.accordionBody: Customer health scores combine multiple data points from product analytics and CRM to assess account status. These typically include product usage metrics (login frequency, feature adoption), customer interaction data (support tickets, response times), and business metrics (contract value, renewal dates). The resulting score helps teams prioritize accounts and take appropriate action based on customer status.
